items.stem: A team wants each project record to show how many of its linked tasks are still open. Which combination achieves this?

options.text: A link to the Tasks table plus a rollup that counts linked tasks where status is open
options.rationale: Correct: a rollup aggregates values from linked records, enabling the count.

options.text: A single long text field listing tasks
options.rationale: Free text cannot be counted or kept in sync.

options.text: Copying the task count in by hand each day
options.rationale: Manual counts go stale and are error-prone.

options.text: A formula in the Tasks table only
options.rationale: Without a rollup on the project side, the project record cannot show the aggregate.

items.explanation: Correct: a rollup aggregates values from linked records, enabling the count.

items.stem: Which TWO choices make an Airtable base easier for a non-technical manager to use safely? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Building an interface that exposes only the needed fields and actions
options.rationale: Correct: an interface hides complexity and reduces accidental edits.

options.text: Granting read-only or limited access instead of full base editing
options.rationale: Correct: limited permissions protect the underlying structure.

options.text: Giving everyone creator access to the base
options.rationale: Broad creator access risks accidental structural damage.

options.text: Hiding the field names entirely from the designer
options.rationale: Designers need field names; this does not help the manager.

items.explanation: Correct: an interface hides complexity and reduces accidental edits.

items.stem: An automation that posts a reminder when a session has no room never fires, though matching records exist. What is the first thing to check?

options.text: Whether the trigger condition and its field actually match the records, by testing the automation
options.rationale: Correct: most non-firing automations have a mismatched or untested trigger condition.

options.text: Whether the base has too many colours
options.rationale: Colour has no effect on automation triggers.

options.text: Whether the records were created on a weekend
options.rationale: Creation day does not gate a condition-based trigger.

options.text: Whether the table name is short enough
options.rationale: Table-name length does not affect triggers.

items.explanation: Correct: most non-firing automations have a mismatched or untested trigger condition.
